018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.lang.StateEnum.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;

029/**
030 * A ZonedDateTime with precision information for granular time operations.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * This class combines a {@link ZonedDateTime} with a {@link ChronoField} precision identifier,
034 * allowing for granular time operations such as rolling by specific time units.
035 *
036 * <p>
037 * The precision field indicates the granularity of the time value, which determines how the
038 * {@link #roll(int)} method behaves. For example, a precision of {@link ChronoField#YEAR} means
039 * rolling by 1 will advance the year, while a precision of {@link ChronoField#HOUR_OF_DAY} means
040 * rolling by 1 will advance the hour.
041 *
042 * <h5 class='section'>ISO8601 Parsing:</h5>
043 * <p>
044 * The {@link #of(String)} method can parse various ISO8601 timestamp formats:
045 * <ul>
046 *    <li>Date formats: <js>"2011"</js>, <js>"2011-01"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15"</js>
047 *    <li>DateTime formats: <js>"2011-01-15T12"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15T12:30"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45"</js>
048 *    <li>With fractional seconds: <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45.123"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45,123"</js>
049 *    <li>Time-only formats: <js>"T12"</js>, <js>"T12:30"</js>, <js>"T12:30:45"</js>
050 *    <li>With timezone: <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45Z"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45+05:30"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45-05:30"</js>
051 * </ul>
052 *
053 * <p>
054 * The precision is automatically determined from the input format. For example:
055 * <ul>
056 *    <li><js>"2011"</js> → {@link ChronoField#YEAR}
057 *    <li><js>"2011-01"</js> → {@link ChronoField#MONTH_OF_YEAR}
058 *    <li><js>"2011-01-15"</js> → {@link ChronoField#DAY_OF_MONTH}
059 *    <li><js>"2011-01-15T12"</js> → {@link ChronoField#HOUR_OF_DAY}
060 *    <li><js>"2011-01-15T12:30"</js> → {@link ChronoField#MINUTE_OF_HOUR}
061 *    <li><js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45"</js> → {@link ChronoField#SECOND_OF_MINUTE}
062 *    <li><js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45.123"</js> → {@link ChronoField#MILLI_OF_SECOND} (1-3 digits)
063 *    <li><js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45.123456789"</js> → {@link ChronoField#NANO_OF_SECOND} (4-9 digits)
064 * </ul>
065 *
066 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
067 * <p class='bjava'>
068 *    <jc>// Parse an ISO8601 timestamp with year precision</jc>
069 *    GranularZonedDateTime <jv>gdt</jv> = GranularZonedDateTime.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"2011"</js>);
070 *    <jc>// Roll forward by one year</jc>
071 *    <jv>gdt</jv> = <jv>gdt</jv>.<jsm>roll</jsm>(1);
072 *    <jc>// Get the ZonedDateTime</jc>
073 *    ZonedDateTime <jv>zdt</jv> = <jv>gdt</jv>.<jsm>getZonedDateTime</jsm>();
074 *    <jc>// Result: 2012-01-01T00:00:00 with system default timezone</jc>
075 * </p>
076 *
077 * <p class='bjava'>
078 *    <jc>// Parse a datetime with hour precision</jc>
079 *    GranularZonedDateTime <jv>gdt2</jv> = GranularZonedDateTime.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"2011-01-15T12Z"</js>);
080 *    <jc>// Roll forward by 2 hours</jc>
081 *    <jv>gdt2</jv> = <jv>gdt2</jv>.<jsm>roll</jsm>(<jv>ChronoField</jv>.<jf>HOUR_OF_DAY</jf>, 2);
082 *    <jc>// Result: 2011-01-15T14:00:00Z</jc>
083 * </p>
084 *
085 * <h5 class='section'>Thread Safety:</h5>
086 * <p>
087 * This class is immutable and thread-safe.
088 *
089 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
090 *    <li class='jm'>{@link ZonedDateTime}
091 *    <li class='jm'>{@link ChronoField}
092 *    <li class='jm'>{@link DateUtils}
093 * </ul>
094 */
095@SuppressWarnings({
096   "java:S115" // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention
097})
098public class GranularZonedDateTime {
099
100   // Argument name constants for assertArgNotNull
101   private static final String ARG_value = "value";
102
103   /**
104    * Creates a GranularZonedDateTime from a Date with the specified precision.
105    *
106    * <p>
107    * The date is converted to a ZonedDateTime using the system default timezone.
108    *
109    * @param date The date to convert.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> (a <jk>null</jk> value throws {@link NullPointerException}).
110    * @param precision The precision of the time value.  Not validated — a <jk>null</jk> value is stored as-is and
111    *    only surfaces later (e.g. {@link #roll(int)} throws {@link NullPointerException} when precision is <jk>null</jk>).
112    * @return A new GranularZonedDateTime instance.
113    * @throws NullPointerException if date is <jk>null</jk>.
114    */
115   public static GranularZonedDateTime of(Date date, ChronoField precision) {
116      return of(date, precision, ZoneId.systemDefault());
117   }
118
119   /**
120    * Creates a GranularZonedDateTime from a Date with the specified precision and timezone.
121    *
122    * <p>
123    * The date is converted to a ZonedDateTime using the specified timezone.
124    *
125    * @param date The date to convert.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> (a <jk>null</jk> value throws {@link NullPointerException}).
126    * @param precision The precision of the time value.  Not validated — a <jk>null</jk> value is stored as-is and
127    *    only surfaces later (e.g. {@link #roll(int)} throws {@link NullPointerException} when precision is <jk>null</jk>).
128    * @param zoneId The timezone to use.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> (a <jk>null</jk> value throws {@link NullPointerException}).
129    * @return A new GranularZonedDateTime instance.
130    * @throws NullPointerException if date or zoneId is <jk>null</jk>.
131    */
132   public static GranularZonedDateTime of(Date date, ChronoField precision, ZoneId zoneId) {
133      return of(date.toInstant().atZone(zoneId), precision);
134   }
135
136   /**
137    * Parses an ISO8601 timestamp string into a GranularZonedDateTime.
138    *
139    * <p>
140    * This method parses various ISO8601 formats and automatically determines the precision
141    * based on the format. If no timezone is specified in the string, the system default
142    * timezone is used.
143    *
144    * <h5 class='section'>Supported Formats:</h5>
145    * <ul>
146    *    <li>Date: <js>"2011"</js>, <js>"2011-01"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15"</js>
147    *    <li>DateTime: <js>"2011-01-15T12"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15T12:30"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45"</js>
148    *    <li>With fractional seconds: <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45.123"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45,123"</js>
149    *    <li>Time-only: <js>"T12"</js>, <js>"T12:30"</js>, <js>"T12:30:45"</js> (uses current date)
150    *    <li>With timezone: <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45Z"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45+05:30"</js>, <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45-05:30"</js>
151    * </ul>
152    *
153    * <h5 class='section'>Timezone Handling:</h5>
154    * <ul>
155    *    <li>If the string contains a timezone (Z, +HH:mm, -HH:mm, etc.), that timezone is used.
156    *    <li>If no timezone is specified, the system default timezone is used.
157    *    <li>For time-only formats (starting with "T"), the current date is used with the specified or default timezone.
158    * </ul>
159    *
160    * <h5 class='section'>Precision Detection:</h5>
161    * <p>
162    * The precision is automatically determined from the format:
163    * <ul>
164    *    <li>Year only → {@link ChronoField#YEAR}
165    *    <li>Year-Month → {@link ChronoField#MONTH_OF_YEAR}
166    *    <li>Year-Month-Day → {@link ChronoField#DAY_OF_MONTH}
167    *    <li>With hour → {@link ChronoField#HOUR_OF_DAY}
168    *    <li>With minute → {@link ChronoField#MINUTE_OF_HOUR}
169    *    <li>With second → {@link ChronoField#SECOND_OF_MINUTE}
170    *    <li>With 1-3 fractional digits → {@link ChronoField#MILLI_OF_SECOND}
171    *    <li>With 4-9 fractional digits → {@link ChronoField#NANO_OF_SECOND}
172    * </ul>
173    *
174    * @param value The ISO8601 timestamp string to parse.
175    * @return A new GranularZonedDateTime instance.
176    * @throws IllegalArgumentException if timestamp is null.
177    * @throws DateTimeParseException if the timestamp format is invalid.
178    */
179   public static GranularZonedDateTime of(String value) {
180      return of(value, null, null);
181   }
182
183   /**
184    * Parses an ISO8601 timestamp string into a GranularZonedDateTime with a custom clock.
185    *
186    * <p>
187    * This method is similar to {@link #of(String)}, but allows you to specify a custom
188    * {@link Clock} to use for obtaining the time zone and current time.
189    * This is useful for testing or when you need deterministic time behavior.
190    *
191    * <p>
192    * The clock is used when:
193    * <ul>
194    *    <li>No timezone is specified in the string - uses {@link Clock#getZone()}
195    *    <li>Time-only formats (starting with "T") - uses the clock's instant to get the current date
196    * </ul>
197    *
198    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
199    * <p class='bjava'>
200    *    <jc>// Parse with a fixed clock for deterministic testing</jc>
201    *    <jk>var</jk> <jv>clock</jv> = Clock.<jsm>fixed</jsm>(Instant.<jsm>parse</jsm>(<js>"2000-01-01T12:00:00Z"</js>), ZoneOffset.<jsf>UTC</jsf>);
202    *    GranularZonedDateTime <jv>gdt</jv> = GranularZonedDateTime.<jsm>of</jsm>(
203    *       <js>"T12:30:45"</js>,
204    *       <jv>clock</jv>
205    *    );
206    *    <jc>// Result uses the clock's current date and timezone</jc>
207    * </p>
208    *
209    * @param value The ISO8601 timestamp string to parse.
210    * @param clock The clock to use for time zone and current time.
211    *    If null, {@link Clock#systemDefaultZone()} is used.
212    * @return A new GranularZonedDateTime instance.
213    * @throws IllegalArgumentException if value is null.
214    * @throws DateTimeParseException if the timestamp format is invalid.
215    */
216   public static GranularZonedDateTime of(String value, Clock clock) {
217      return of(value, null, clock);
218   }
219
220
221   /**
222    * Parses an ISO8601 timestamp string into a GranularZonedDateTime with a default timezone and custom clock.
223    *
224    * <p>
225    * This method is similar to {@link #of(String)}, but allows you to specify both a default
226    * timezone and a custom {@link Clock} to use when no timezone is present in the timestamp string.
227    *
228    * <p>
229    * If the timestamp string contains a timezone (Z, +HH:mm, -HH:mm, etc.), that timezone
230    * takes precedence over the defaultZoneId parameter. The defaultZoneId is only used when
231    * no timezone is specified in the string.
232    *
233    * <p>
234    * The clock is used when:
235    * <ul>
236    *    <li>No timezone is specified and defaultZoneId is null - uses {@link Clock#getZone()}
237    *    <li>Time-only formats (starting with "T") - uses the clock's instant to get the current date
238    * </ul>
239    *
240    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
241    * <p class='bjava'>
242    *    <jc>// Parse with default timezone and a fixed clock</jc>
243    *    <jk>var</jk> <jv>clock</jv> = Clock.<jsm>fixed</jsm>(Instant.<jsm>parse</jsm>(<js>"2000-01-01T12:00:00Z"</js>), ZoneOffset.<jsf>UTC</jsf>);
244    *    GranularZonedDateTime <jv>gdt1</jv> = GranularZonedDateTime.<jsm>of</jsm>(
245    *       <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45"</js>,
246    *       <jv>ZoneId</jv>.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"America/New_York"</js>),
247    *       <jv>clock</jv>
248    *    );
249    *    <jc>// Result uses America/New_York timezone</jc>
250    *
251    *    <jc>// Parse with timezone in string (defaultZoneId is ignored)</jc>
252    *    GranularZonedDateTime <jv>gdt2</jv> = GranularZonedDateTime.<jsm>of</jsm>(
253    *       <js>"2011-01-15T12:30:45Z"</js>,
254    *       <jv>ZoneId</jv>.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"America/New_York"</js>),
255    *       <jv>clock</jv>
256    *    );
257    *    <jc>// Result uses UTC (Z), not America/New_York</jc>
258    * </p>
259    *
260    * @param value The ISO8601 timestamp string to parse.
261    * @param defaultZoneId The default timezone to use if no timezone is specified in the string.
262    *    If null, the clock's time zone is used.
263    * @param clock The clock to use for time zone and current time.
264    *    If null, {@link Clock#systemDefaultZone()} is used.
265    * @return A new GranularZonedDateTime instance.
266    * @throws IllegalArgumentException if value is null.
267    * @throws DateTimeParseException if the timestamp format is invalid.
268    */
269   
270   @SuppressWarnings({
271      "java:S6541", // Single-threaded context; synchronization unnecessary
272      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for this specific logic
273   })
274   public static GranularZonedDateTime of(String value, ZoneId defaultZoneId, Clock clock) {
275      assertArgNotNull(ARG_value, value);
276      var digit = StringUtils.DIGIT;
277      clock = clock == null ? Clock.systemDefaultZone() : clock;
278
279      // States:
280      // S01: Looking for Y(S02) or T(S07).
281      // S02: Found Y, looking for Y(S02)/-(S03)/T(S07).
282      // S03: Found -, looking for M(S04).
283      // S04: Found M, looking for M(S04)/-(S05)/T(S07).
284      // S05: Found -, looking for D(S10).
285      // S06  Found D, looking for D(S06)/T(S07).
286      // S07: Found T, looking for h(S08)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17).
287      // S08: Found h, looking for h(S08)/:(S09)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17).
288      // S09: Found :, looking for m(S10).
289      // S10: Found m, looking for m(S10)/:(S11)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17).
290      // S11: Found :, looking for s(S12).
291      // S12: Found s, looking for s(S12)/.(S13)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17).
292      // S13: Found ., looking for S(S14)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17).
293      // S14: Found S, looking for S(S14)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17).
294      // S15: Found Z.
295      // S16: Found +, looking for oh(S18).
296      // S17: Found -, looking for oh(S18).
297      // S18: Found oh, looking for oh(S18)/:(S19).
298      // S19: Found :, looking for om(S20).
299      // S20: Found om, looking for om(S20).
300
301
302      int year = 1;
303      int month = 1;
304      int day = 1;
305      int hour = 0;
306      int minute = 0;
307      int second = 0;
308      int nanos = 0;
309      int ohour = -1;
310      int ominute = -1;
311      boolean nego = false; // negative offset
312      boolean timeOnly = false; // Track if format started with "T" (time-only)
313      ZoneId zoneId = null;
314      var state = S1;
315      var mark = 0;
316      ChronoField precision = ChronoField.YEAR; // Track precision as we go
317
318      for (var i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
319         var c = value.charAt(i);
320
321         if (state == S1) {
322            // S01: Looking for Y(S02) or T(S07)
323            if (digit.contains(c)) {
324               mark = i;
325               state = S2;
326            } else if (c == 'T') {
327               timeOnly = true; // Mark as time-only format
328               state = S7;
329            } else {
330               throw bad(value, i);
331            }
332         } else if (state == S2) {
333            // S02: Found Y, looking for Y(S02)/-(S03)/T(S07)
334            if (digit.contains(c)) {
335               // Stay in S2
336            } else if (c == '-') {
337               year = parse(value, 4, mark, i, 0, 9999);
338               state = S3;
339            } else if (c == 'T') {
340               year = parse(value, 4, mark, i, 0, 9999);
341               state = S7;
342            } else if (c == 'Z') {
343               zoneId = ZoneId.of("Z");
344               year = parse(value, 4, mark, i, 0, 9999);
345               state = S15;
346            } else if (c == '+') {
347               year = parse(value, 4, mark, i, 0, 9999);
348               nego = false;
349               state = S16;
350            } else {
351               throw bad(value, i);
352            }
353         } else if (state == S3) {
354            // S03: Found -, looking for M(S04)
355            if (digit.contains(c)) {
356               mark = i;
357               state = S4;
358               precision = ChronoField.MONTH_OF_YEAR;
359            } else {
360               throw bad(value, i);
361            }
362         } else if (state == S4) {
363            // S04: Found M, looking for M(S04)/-(S05)/T(S07)
364            if (digit.contains(c)) {
365               // Stay in S4
366            } else if (c == '-') {
367               month = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 1, 12);
368               state = S5;
369            } else if (c == 'T') {
370               month = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 1, 12);
371               state = S7;
372            } else if (c == 'Z') {
373               month = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 1, 12);
374               zoneId = ZoneId.of("Z");
375               state = S15;
376            } else if (c == '+') {
377               month = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 1, 12);
378               nego = false;
379               state = S16;
380            } else {
381               throw bad(value, i);
382            }
383         } else if (state == S5) {
384            // S05: Found -, looking for D(S06)
385            if (digit.contains(c)) {
386               mark = i;
387               state = S6;
388               precision = ChronoField.DAY_OF_MONTH;
389            } else {
390               throw bad(value, i);
391            }
392         } else if (state == S6) {
393            // S06: Found D, looking for D(S06)/T(S07)
394            if (digit.contains(c)) {
395               // Stay in S6
396            } else if (c == 'T') {
397               day = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 1, 31);
398               state = S7;
399            } else if (c == 'Z') {
400               day = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 1, 31);
401               zoneId = ZoneId.of("Z");
402               state = S15;
403            } else if (c == '+') {
404               day = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 1, 31);
405               nego = false;
406               state = S16;
407            } else if (c == '-') {
408               day = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 1, 31);
409               nego = true;
410               state = S17;
411            } else {
412               throw bad(value, i);
413            }
414         } else if (state == S7) {
415            // S07: Found T, looking for h(S08)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17)
416            if (digit.contains(c)) {
417               mark = i;
418               state = S8;
419               precision = ChronoField.HOUR_OF_DAY;
420            } else if (c == 'Z') {
421               zoneId = ZoneId.of("Z");
422               if (timeOnly) {
423                  precision = ChronoField.HOUR_OF_DAY;
424               }
425               state = S15;
426            } else if (c == '+') {
427               nego = false;
428               if (timeOnly) {
429                  precision = ChronoField.HOUR_OF_DAY;
430               }
431               state = S16;
432            } else if (c == '-') {
433               nego = true;
434               if (timeOnly) {
435                  precision = ChronoField.HOUR_OF_DAY;
436               }
437               state = S17;
438            } else {
439               throw bad(value, i);
440            }
441         } else if (state == S8) {
442            // S08: Found h, looking for h(S08)/:(S09)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17)
443            if (digit.contains(c)) {
444               // Stay in S8
445            } else if (c == ':') {
446               hour = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 23);
447               state = S9;
448            } else if (c == 'Z') {
449               hour = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 23);
450               zoneId = ZoneId.of("Z");
451               state = S15;
452            } else if (c == '+') {
453               hour = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 23);
454               nego = false;
455               state = S16;
456            } else if (c == '-') {
457               hour = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 23);
458               nego = true;
459               state = S17;
460            } else {
461               throw bad(value, i);
462            }
463         } else if (state == S9) {
464            // S09: Found :, looking for m(S10)
465            if (digit.contains(c)) {
466               mark = i;
467               state = S10;
468               precision = ChronoField.MINUTE_OF_HOUR;
469            } else {
470               throw bad(value, i);
471            }
472         } else if (state == S10) {
473            // S10: Found m, looking for m(S10)/:(S11)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17)
474            if (digit.contains(c)) {
475               // Stay in S10
476            } else if (c == ':') {
477               minute = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 59);
478               state = S11;
479            } else if (c == 'Z') {
480               minute = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 59);
481               zoneId = ZoneId.of("Z");
482               state = S15;
483            } else if (c == '+') {
484               minute = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 59);
485               nego = false;
486               state = S16;
487            } else if (c == '-') {
488               minute = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 59);
489               nego = true;
490               state = S17;
491            } else {
492               throw bad(value, i);
493            }
494         } else if (state == S11) {
495            // S11: Found :, looking for s(S12)
496            if (digit.contains(c)) {
497               mark = i;
498               state = S12;
499               precision = ChronoField.SECOND_OF_MINUTE;
500            } else {
501               throw bad(value, i);
502            }
503         } else if (state == S12) {
504            // S12: Found s, looking for s(S12)/.(S13)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17)
505            if (digit.contains(c)) {
506               // Stay in S12
507         } else if (c == '.' || c == ',') {
508            second = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 59);
509            state = S13;
510            // Precision will be set based on number of fractional digits
511            } else if (c == 'Z') {
512               second = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 59);
513               zoneId = ZoneId.of("Z");
514               state = S15;
515            } else if (c == '+') {
516               second = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 59);
517               nego = false;
518               state = S16;
519            } else if (c == '-') {
520               second = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 59);
521               nego = true;
522               state = S17;
523            } else {
524               throw bad(value, i);
525            }
526         } else if (state == S13) {
527            // S13: Found . or ,, looking for S(S14)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17)
528            if (digit.contains(c)) {
529               mark = i;
530               state = S14;
531            } else if (c == 'Z') {
532               zoneId = ZoneId.of("Z");
533               state = S15;
534            } else if (c == '+') {
535               nego = false;
536               state = S16;
537            } else if (c == '-') {
538               nego = true;
539               state = S17;
540            } else {
541               throw bad(value, i);
542            }
543         } else if (state == S14) {
544            // S14: Found S, looking for S(S14)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17)
545            if (digit.contains(c)) {
546               // Stay in S14
547            } else if (c == 'Z') {
548               nanos = parseNanos(value, mark, i);
549               zoneId = ZoneId.of("Z");
550               // Set precision based on number of fractional digits: 1-3 = milliseconds, 4-9 = nanoseconds
551               var digitCount = i - mark;
552               precision = (digitCount <= 3) ? ChronoField.MILLI_OF_SECOND : ChronoField.NANO_OF_SECOND;
553               state = S15;
554            } else if (c == '+') {
555               nanos = parseNanos(value, mark, i);
556               // Set precision based on number of fractional digits: 1-3 = milliseconds, 4-9 = nanoseconds
557               var digitCount = i - mark;
558               precision = (digitCount <= 3) ? ChronoField.MILLI_OF_SECOND : ChronoField.NANO_OF_SECOND;
559               nego = false;
560               state = S16;
561            } else if (c == '-') {
562               nanos = parseNanos(value, mark, i);
563               // Set precision based on number of fractional digits: 1-3 = milliseconds, 4-9 = nanoseconds
564               var digitCount = i - mark;
565               precision = (digitCount <= 3) ? ChronoField.MILLI_OF_SECOND : ChronoField.NANO_OF_SECOND;
566               nego = true;
567               state = S17;
568            } else {
569               throw bad(value, i);
570            }
571         } else if (state == S15) {
572            // Shouldn't find anything after Z
573            throw bad(value, i);
574         } else if (state == S16) {
575            // S16: Found +, looking for oh(S18)
576            if (digit.contains(c)) {
577               mark = i;
578               state = S18;
579            } else {
580               throw bad(value, i);
581            }
582         } else if (state == S17) {
583            // S17: Found -, looking for oh(S18)
584            if (digit.contains(c)) {
585               mark = i;
586               state = S18;
587            } else {
588               throw bad(value, i);
589            }
590         } else if (state == S18) {
591            // S18: Found oh, looking for oh(S18)/:(S19)/end
592            if (digit.contains(c)) {
593               // Stay in S18
594            } else if (c == ':') {
595               ohour = parse(value, 2, mark, i, 0, 18);
596               state = S19;
597            } else {
598               throw bad(value, i);
599            }
600            // If we reach end of string, ohour is complete (2 digits)
601         } else if (state == S19) {
602            // S19: Found :, looking for om(S20)
603            if (digit.contains(c)) {
604               mark = i;
605               state = S20;
606            } else {
607               throw bad(value, i);
608            }
609         } else /* (state == S20) */ {
610            // S20: Found om, looking for om(S20)
611            if (digit.contains(c)) {
612               // Stay in S20
613            } else {
614               throw bad(value, i);
615            }
616         }
617      }
618
619      var end = value.length(); // end is exclusive (one past last character)
620      if (state.isAny(S1, S3, S5, S7, S9, S11, S13, S16, S17, S19)) {
621         throw bad(value, end - 1);
622      } else if (state == S2) {
623         // S02: Found Y, looking for Y(S02)/-(S03)/T(S07).
624         year = parse(value, 4, mark, end, 0, 9999);
625         precision = ChronoField.YEAR;
626      } else if (state == S4) {
627         // S04: Found M, looking for M(S04)/-(S05)/T(S07).
628         month = parse(value, 2, mark, end, 1, 12);
629         precision = ChronoField.MONTH_OF_YEAR;
630      } else if (state == S6) {
631         // S06  Found D, looking for D(S06)/T(S07).
632         day = parse(value, 2, mark, end, 1, 31);
633         precision = ChronoField.DAY_OF_MONTH;
634      } else if (state == S8) {
635         // S08: Found h, looking for h(S08)/:(S09)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17).
636         hour = parse(value, 2, mark, end, 0, 23);
637         precision = ChronoField.HOUR_OF_DAY;
638      } else if (state == S10) {
639         // S10: Found m, looking for m(S10)/:(S11)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17).
640         minute = parse(value, 2, mark, end, 0, 59);
641         precision = ChronoField.MINUTE_OF_HOUR;
642      } else if (state == S12) {
643         // S12: Found s, looking for s(S12)/.(S13)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17).
644         second = parse(value, 2, mark, end, 0, 59);
645         precision = ChronoField.SECOND_OF_MINUTE;
646      } else if (state == S14) {
647         // S14: Found S, looking for S(S14)/Z(S15)/+(S16)/-(S17).
648         nanos = parseNanos(value, mark, end);
649         // Set precision based on number of digits: 1-3 = milliseconds, 4-9 = nanoseconds
650         var digitCount = end - mark;
651         precision = (digitCount <= 3) ? ChronoField.MILLI_OF_SECOND : ChronoField.NANO_OF_SECOND;
652      } else if (state == S15) {
653         // S15: Found Z.
654      } else if (state == S18) {
655         // S18: Found oh, looking for oh(S18)/:(S19).
656         // Check if we have 2 digits (+hh) or 4 digits (+hhmm)
657         if (end - mark == 2) {
658            ohour = parse(value, 2, mark, end, 0, 18);
659         } else if (end - mark == 4) {
660            // +hhmm format: parse hours from mark to mark+2, minutes from mark+2 to end
661            ohour = parse(value, 2, mark, mark + 2, 0, 18);
662            ominute = parse(value, 2, mark + 2, end, 0, 59);
663         } else {
664            throw bad(value, mark);
665         }
666      } else /* (state == S20) */ {
667         // S20: Found om, looking for om(S20).
668         ominute = parse(value, 2, mark, end, 0, 59);
669      }
670
671      // Build ZoneId if we have offset information
672      if (zoneId == null && ohour >= 0) {
673         if (ominute >= 0) {
674            // If negative offset, both hours and minutes must be negative
675            var offset = ZoneOffset.ofHoursMinutes(nego ? -ohour : ohour, nego ? -ominute : ominute);
676            zoneId = offset;
677         } else {
678            var offset = ZoneOffset.ofHours(nego ? -ohour : ohour);
679            zoneId = offset;
680         }
681      }
682
683      // Use provided default zone if no zone specified, otherwise use the clock's zone
684      if (zoneId == null) {
685         zoneId = defaultZoneId != null ? defaultZoneId : clock.getZone();
686      }
687
688      // Construct ZonedDateTime from parsed values
689      // Default values for missing components
690      // For time-only formats (started with "T"), use current date
691      // For date formats, default to 1/1/1
692      if (timeOnly) {
693         // Time-only format: use current year/month/day as read from the clock in the resolved zone
694         var now = ZonedDateTime.now(clock.withZone(zoneId));
695         year = now.getYear();
696         month = now.getMonthValue();
697         day = now.getDayOfMonth();
698      }
699
700      var localDateTime = LocalDateTime.of(year, month, day, hour, minute, second);
701      if (nanos > 0) {
702         localDateTime = localDateTime.plusNanos(nanos);
703      }
704
705      var zdt = ZonedDateTime.of(localDateTime, zoneId);
706
707      // Return GranularZonedDateTime with the determined precision
708      return new GranularZonedDateTime(zdt, precision);
709   }
710
711   /**
712    * Creates a GranularZonedDateTime from a ZonedDateTime with the specified precision.
713    *
714    * <p>
715    * This is the most direct way to create a GranularZonedDateTime when you already have
716    * a ZonedDateTime and want to specify its precision.
717    *
718    * @param date The ZonedDateTime value.  Not validated — a <jk>null</jk> value is stored as-is.
719    * @param precision The precision of the time value.  Not validated — a <jk>null</jk> value is stored as-is.
720    *    <br>Neither argument is null-checked here; a <jk>null</jk> value only surfaces later (e.g. {@link #roll(int)}
721    *    or {@link #toString()} throw {@link NullPointerException} when the corresponding field is <jk>null</jk>).
722    * @return A new GranularZonedDateTime instance.
723    */
724   public static GranularZonedDateTime of(ZonedDateTime date, ChronoField precision) {
725      return new GranularZonedDateTime(date, precision);
726   }
727
728
729   private static DateTimeParseException bad(String s, int pos) {
730      return new DateTimeParseException("Invalid ISO8601 timestamp", s, pos);
731   }
732
733   private static int parse(String s, int chars, int pos, int end, int min, int max) {
734      if (end-pos != chars) throw bad(s, pos);
735      var i = Integer.parseInt(s, pos, end, 10);
736      if (i < min || i > max) throw bad(s, pos);
737      return i;
738   }
739
740   private static int parseNanos(String s, int pos, int end) {
741      var len = end - pos; // Length of the substring being parsed
742      if (len > 9) {
743         throw bad(s, pos);
744      }
745      var n = Integer.parseInt(s, pos, end, 10);
746      // Convert to nanoseconds based on number of digits
747      // 1 digit = hundreds of milliseconds, 2 = tens, 3 = milliseconds, etc.
748      if (len == 1) return n * 100000000;
749      if (len == 2) return n * 10000000;
750      if (len == 3) return n * 1000000;
751      if (len == 4) return n * 100000;
752      if (len == 5) return n * 10000;
753      if (len == 6) return n * 1000;
754      if (len == 7) return n * 100;
755      if (len == 8) return n * 10;
756      return n;
757   }
758
759   /**
760    * Converts a ChronoField to its corresponding ChronoUnit.
761    *
762    * <p>
763    * This method provides a mapping from date/time fields to time units.
764    * Not all ChronoField values have direct ChronoUnit equivalents.
765    *
766    * <p>
767    * Supported fields:
768    * <ul>
769    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#YEAR} → {@link ChronoUnit#YEARS}
770    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#MONTH_OF_YEAR} → {@link ChronoUnit#MONTHS}
771    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#DAY_OF_MONTH} → {@link ChronoUnit#DAYS}
772    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#HOUR_OF_DAY} → {@link ChronoUnit#HOURS}
773    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#MINUTE_OF_HOUR} → {@link ChronoUnit#MINUTES}
774    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#SECOND_OF_MINUTE} → {@link ChronoUnit#SECONDS}
775    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#MILLI_OF_SECOND} → {@link ChronoUnit#MILLIS}
776    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#NANO_OF_SECOND} → {@link ChronoUnit#NANOS}
777    * </ul>
778    *
779    * @param field The ChronoField to convert
780    * @return The corresponding ChronoUnit, or null if no direct mapping exists
781    */
782   private static ChronoUnit toChronoUnit(ChronoField field) {
783      return switch (field) {
784         case YEAR -> ChronoUnit.YEARS;
785         case MONTH_OF_YEAR -> ChronoUnit.MONTHS;
786         case DAY_OF_MONTH -> ChronoUnit.DAYS;
787         case HOUR_OF_DAY -> ChronoUnit.HOURS;
788         case MINUTE_OF_HOUR -> ChronoUnit.MINUTES;
789         case SECOND_OF_MINUTE -> ChronoUnit.SECONDS;
790         case MILLI_OF_SECOND -> ChronoUnit.MILLIS;
791         case NANO_OF_SECOND -> ChronoUnit.NANOS;
792         default -> null;
793      };
794   }
795
796   /** The ZonedDateTime value */
797   public final ZonedDateTime zdt;
798
799   /** The precision of this time value */
800   public final ChronoField precision;
801
802   /**
803    * Constructor.
804    *
805    * @param zdt The ZonedDateTime value.
806    * @param precision The precision of this time value.
807    */
808   public GranularZonedDateTime(ZonedDateTime zdt, ChronoField precision) {
809      this.zdt = zdt;
810      this.precision = precision;
811   }
812
813   /**
814    * Creates a copy of this object.
815    *
816    * @return A new GranularZonedDateTime with the same values.
817    */
818   public GranularZonedDateTime copy() {
819      return new GranularZonedDateTime(zdt, precision);
820   }
821
822   /**
823    * Returns the ZonedDateTime value.
824    *
825    * @return The ZonedDateTime value.
826    */
827   public ZonedDateTime getZonedDateTime() { return zdt; }
828
829   /**
830    * Returns the precision of this time value.
831    *
832    * <p>
833    * The precision indicates the finest granularity of the time value, which determines
834    * how the value was parsed or created. For example:
835    * <ul>
836    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#YEAR} - Year precision (e.g., "2011")
837    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#MONTH_OF_YEAR} - Month precision (e.g., "2011-01")
838    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#DAY_OF_MONTH} - Day precision (e.g., "2011-01-15")
839    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#HOUR_OF_DAY} - Hour precision (e.g., "2011-01-15T12")
840    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#MINUTE_OF_HOUR} - Minute precision (e.g., "2011-01-15T12:30")
841    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#SECOND_OF_MINUTE} - Second precision (e.g., "2011-01-15T12:30:45")
842    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#MILLI_OF_SECOND} - Millisecond precision (e.g., "2011-01-15T12:30:45.123")
843    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#NANO_OF_SECOND} - Nanosecond precision (e.g., "2011-01-15T12:30:45.123456789")
844    * </ul>
845    *
846    * @return The precision of this time value.
847    */
848   public ChronoField getPrecision() { return precision; }
849
850   @Override
851   public String toString() {
852      return zdt.format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_OFFSET_DATE_TIME) + "(" + precision + ")";
853   }
854
855   /**
856    * Rolls this time value by the specified amount using the specified field.
857    *
858    * <p>
859    * This method creates a new GranularZonedDateTime by adding the specified amount to the
860    * specified field. The precision of the returned object remains the same as this object.
861    *
862    * <h5 class='section'>Supported Fields:</h5>
863    * <ul>
864    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#YEAR}
865    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#MONTH_OF_YEAR}
866    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#DAY_OF_MONTH}
867    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#HOUR_OF_DAY}
868    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#MINUTE_OF_HOUR}
869    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#SECOND_OF_MINUTE}
870    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#MILLI_OF_SECOND}
871    *    <li>{@link ChronoField#NANO_OF_SECOND}
872    * </ul>
873    *
874    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
875    * <p class='bjava'>
876    *    <jc>// Create a datetime with hour precision</jc>
877    *    GranularZonedDateTime <jv>gdt</jv> = GranularZonedDateTime.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"2011-01-15T12Z"</js>);
878    *    <jc>// Roll forward by 2 hours</jc>
879    *    <jv>gdt</jv> = <jv>gdt</jv>.<jsm>roll</jsm>(<jv>ChronoField</jv>.<jf>HOUR_OF_DAY</jf>, 2);
880    *    <jc>// Result: 2011-01-15T14:00:00Z (precision still HOUR_OF_DAY)</jc>
881    * </p>
882    *
883    * @param field The field to roll by. Must be one of the supported fields listed above.
884    * @param amount The amount to roll by. Positive values roll forward, negative values roll backward.
885    * @return A new GranularZonedDateTime with the rolled value.
886    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the field is not supported.
887    */
888   public GranularZonedDateTime roll(ChronoField field, int amount) {
889      var unit = toChronoUnit(field);
890      assertArg(unit != null, "Unsupported roll field: %s", field);
891      var newZdt = zdt.plus(amount, unit);
892      return new GranularZonedDateTime(newZdt, precision);
893   }
894
895   /**
896    * Rolls this time value by the specified amount using the current precision.
897    *
898    * <p>
899    * This is a convenience method that calls {@link #roll(ChronoField, int)} using this
900    * object's precision field.
901    *
902    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
903    * <p class='bjava'>
904    *    <jc>// Create a datetime with year precision</jc>
905    *    GranularZonedDateTime <jv>gdt</jv> = GranularZonedDateTime.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"2011"</js>);
906    *    <jc>// Roll forward by 1 (using YEAR precision)</jc>
907    *    <jv>gdt</jv> = <jv>gdt</jv>.<jsm>roll</jsm>(1);
908    *    <jc>// Result: 2012-01-01T00:00:00 (precision still YEAR)</jc>
909    * </p>
910    *
911    * @param amount The amount to roll by. Positive values roll forward, negative values roll backward.
912    * @return A new GranularZonedDateTime with the rolled value.
913    */
914   public GranularZonedDateTime roll(int amount) {
915      return roll(precision, amount);
916   }
917}
